goal: Find today's work and enter a collection task
attention: Overdue/today/next work, then current holdings and recorded facts
waste: Repeated large metric surfaces and navigation chrome compete with the useful queue
navigation: Use one direct Schedule entry and compact collection entry points rather than a wall of destinations
complexity: Separating operational History, Journal occurrences and future work must remain explicit
change: A makes work the large first region; B makes a photographic collection portrait first. Recommend A for daily use
tradeoff: A reduces visual discovery; B delays work and depends on real assigned imagery

goal: Locate a physical lot, check remaining stock and act
attention: Identity/lot, quantity knowledge/unit, storage and acquisition precision
waste: Unselected Quick Preview reserves a column; enclosing directory headings repeat the title
navigation: One explicit preview before detail, preserve query/page/selection on Back
complexity: Selection, bulk eligibility and current/history cannot be collapsed into a generic card action
change: A uses full-width inventory columns; B uses richer rows. Recommend A; open inspector only with a selected record
tradeoff: A scans stock faster but pictures are secondary; B offers recognition with fewer records visible

goal: Review a propagation record and its outcomes
attention: Source SeedLot, stage, recorded dates and result quantities
waste: Repeated summary framing and verbose per-record action surfaces
navigation: Keep source chooser and a direct source link; don't introduce another wizard entry layer
complexity: Sowing outcomes and source lineage have distinct validation/eligibility
change: Reuse compact header, rows and explicit actions; retain guided creation and outcome ownership
tradeoff: Less decorative framing; do not erase meaningful propagation detail for density

goal: Locate an owned individual or managed group and act
attention: Record identity, type, physical location and lifecycle
waste: Large cards give equal emphasis to repeated context when scanning maintenance work
navigation: Preview on selection, direct detail and return context; retain one Plants destination with explicit type filter
complexity: Groups are managed records, not a count of individual Plants; source relationships remain explicit
change: A operational table vs B photographic browse. Recommend A as default; B is a secondary representation only after acceptance
tradeoff: B is attractive with real primary photos but weak with missing images and long cultivar labels

goal: Read collected historical material and manage related operations
attention: Harvest occurrence, collected quantity/unit and source
waste: Extra border/heading layers can be reduced but the historical/material split has real value
navigation: Retain explicit links to managed stored remainder rather than folding it into collected stock
complexity: Conversions and reversals require existing guards; a merged stock number would mislead
change: Keep domain composition; adopt intrinsic header and row spacing as a later narrow refinement
tradeoff: Some detail remains dense because collected and stored are different facts

goal: Manage the remainder of collected material
attention: Remaining quantity/unit, Harvest linkage and current location
waste: Generic repeated helper copy can shrink; quantitative distinctions stay
navigation: Keep contextual access from Harvests and Labels; no new top-level sidebar category
complexity: Available, converted and consumed quantities retain their server-owned ledger
change: Keep bounded inventory; share controls/states without making it a photographic browse page
tradeoff: Compact rows need clear units; never trade quantity truth for uniform cards

goal: Find a physical place and understand direct/inclusive use
attention: Hierarchy path, scopes, active state and direct vs descendants counts
waste: An empty detail placeholder is unhelpful; selected context is useful
navigation: Keep outline and selected context together; full detail remains directly addressable
complexity: Scopes do not inherit; location is not provenance or supplier lineage
change: Retain hierarchy; selection opens useful contextual panel, collapse to one mobile path. Existing full detail already uses a suitable usage table
tradeoff: Split view helps orientation but must close/stack at narrow width;297 is not valid evidence of a broken detail

goal: Read and record observations and performed work
attention: Occurrence precision, activity kind, target and useful note
waste: Multiple bordered cards and expanded boilerplate notes slow chronological scan
navigation: Keep direct target access and Record action, no detour through History
complexity: Occurred date can be unknown; recorded UTC timestamp is a different fact
change: Compact chronology, clear source/target and expandable note; preserve mutation ownership
tradeoff: Collapsed notes reduce passive visibility; first useful context should remain in the row

goal: Inspect authoritative operational evidence
attention: What happened, target/source and honest time semantics
waste: Repeated card framing can reduce; read-only status is useful context
navigation: Direct source/target links, preserve query; no edit affordance for projection facts
complexity: Deduplication and recorded completion without an occurrence remain explicit
change: Keep read-only projection, refine chronology using the same frame as Journal
tradeoff: Uniform chronology must not imply every History row is an operator event

goal: Find intended work and complete/cancel it correctly
attention: Due precision, derived overdue, target and state
waste: Expanded notes and repeated action borders consume scan space
navigation: Retain direct Calendar/List choice and target context; completion workflow stays owned
complexity: Completion time is not occurrence time; completing may optionally record a Journal Event
change: Compact due/work/action rows, notes secondary; don't invent Saved Views dimensions or Week view
tradeoff: Shorter rows require clear labels and preserved completion evidence

goal: Understand intended work by month and open a task
attention: Current period, due date and intended task
waste: Standardize surrounding controls only; grid cells need space
navigation: Keep period navigation, Today and mobile agenda; no fake alternate temporal model
complexity: Multi-day/partial due dates and overdue retain existing semantics
change: Preserve accepted monthly calendar/agenda; high-fidelity specimen demonstrates framing and selection
tradeoff: Monthly planning is less dense than a list; that is intentional, not a reason to force tables

goal: Recognize a botanical identity and inspect collection coverage
attention: Scientific name/cultivar, common name, actual active SeedLot/Plant coverage, real cover availability
waste: Empty Quick Preview takes width; repeated directory headings compete with reference names
navigation: Open the hub directly from the full-width index and preserve result context; a second preview would repeat the name and coverage already visible
complexity: Species and cultivar identities cannot borrow counts/covers from each other
change: A visual reference index vs B analytical table; recommend A when actual covers exist, B remains efficient no-cover alternative
tradeoff: Photography adds recognition but current captured covers are absent; don't hide unknown imagery with unrelated specimen photos

goal: Inspect collection-aware classification and placement evidence
attention: Local identity, confirmed source and unresolved placement
waste: Only surrounding duplicated chrome needs convergence
navigation: Preserve accepted list/tree navigation and local fallback
complexity: WFO availability/source confirmation are not interchangeable with local labels
change: Keep delivered Taxonomy composition; no second classification hierarchy
tradeoff: Missing WFO is an environmental/source state, not license to fabricate a graph

goal: Explore accepted taxonomy graph
attention: Selected branch, ancestry, viewport and source evidence
waste: Avoid added cards around the scientific canvas
navigation: Retain selected branch/camera/fullscreen and textual equivalent
complexity: Graph keyboard and identity selection are specialist contracts
change: Preserve accepted graph architecture; shared header/dialog changes require its regressions
tradeoff: This audit only captured local fallback; live graph acceptance remains with its delivered evidence

goal: Browse, inspect and link photographic assets
attention: Image, real metadata and actual linked records
waste: The approved Media workstream already redesigns photographic composition
navigation: Keep its gallery/detail/offset/card-focus model
complexity: Record primary photo, Identity cover, linked media and external load remain separate
change: Integrate approved Media candidate; don't produce a rival photographic redesign
tradeoff: Owner evidence is reported separately; global template work must not regress its scoped F01/F09 fixes

goal: Choose the right scientific geography workspace
attention: Evidence type and workspace purpose
waste: Do not turn this small index into a metrics dashboard
navigation: Keep direct workspace entries and frozen Geography macro destination
complexity: Reference ranges, occurrences and recorded origins are three different contracts
change: Keep index; align shared controls only
tradeoff: An extra explicit choice is useful when it prevents mixing evidence

goal: Inspect structured botanical reference geography
attention: Selected identity, source assertions, legend and textual equivalent
waste: Cards surrounding the map should not displace the map
navigation: Keep map/list selection synchronization and source review access
complexity: Structured range is not occurrence density or recorded provenance
change: Preserve map-dominant composition; use optional context without new inference
tradeoff: Source gaps remain visible; attractive map fill cannot imply unsupported native range

goal: Explicitly load observed occurrence density for one identity
attention: Provider state, selected identity, evidence qualifier and map
waste: Only standardize shared surrounding chrome
navigation: Retain explicit provider load; selection/search/restore must remain provider-free
complexity: Do not infer native range, provenance or multi-species support from occurrences
change: Keep accepted bounded occurrence workspace
tradeoff: Provider latency/source limits remain; UI density is not a reason for implicit loading

goal: Inspect recorded collection origins
attention: Recorded material evidence, precision and associated targets
waste: No additional summary cards without actual aggregate value
navigation: Keep records synchronized with map and a textual list
complexity: Origins are recorded provenance, not storage, supplier or botanical native range
change: Keep scientific composition and explicit uncertainty
tradeoff: Sparse genuine evidence is preferable to a visually complete invented map

goal: Inspect geographical reference places used by existing records
attention: Place name, type and available recorded geography
waste: Repeated headings/helper surfaces can be condensed
navigation: Keep contextual geography routes rather than sidebar expansion
complexity: A reference place is not a precise provenance site
change: Reuse directory frame and optional selection; preserve actual domain fields
tradeoff: More shared presentation is safe only while types and precision remain explicit

goal: Inspect precise recorded provenance sites
attention: Recorded site identity and available exact/uncertain position
waste: Duplicated framing competes with the useful record list
navigation: Direct context and selected detail without empty preview reservation
complexity: Do not create provenance from current Location or Supplier
change: Reuse directory controls, compact records and truthful empty states
tradeoff: No-map/no-position state remains legitimate and useful

goal: Find an acquisition source, contact and linked context
attention: Supplier name and recorded contact/source relationships
waste: Generic cards repeat helper text; no value in fake purchase metrics
navigation: A compact list opens contextual detail, distinct from Order transaction detail
complexity: Direct material sources and Orders remain separate link groups
change: Use richer compact rows; detail groups real relationships and suppresses empty framing
tradeoff: Contact-heavy suppliers may need variable-height rows; don't force equal photography cards

goal: Locate a transaction and reconcile its physical packets
attention: Reference, Supplier, date precision and total price/currency
waste: Card framing reduces cross-order comparison; packet and transaction headings compete
navigation: One transaction table, detail with explicit Add/Link packet action
complexity: Unknown Supplier/price stay unknown; Order date doesn't fill acquisition date
change: Table-led directory and concise transaction detail; reconciliation and deletion guards unchanged
tradeoff: Tables suit financial comparison but must become labelled mobile records rather than hiding currency or unknowns

goal: Compose and print bounded collection labels
attention: Record kind, copies/totals/pages, chosen format and configured QR destination
waste: Shared chrome can shrink; physical print geometry must stay explicit
navigation: Keep canonical composer and contextual source access
complexity: SeedLot/Plant/PlantGroup/Stored only; unknown values and physical units remain honest
change: Keep accepted label architecture; refine shared controls only
tradeoff: Screen mockups cannot certify A4 or50×30mm output or unset QR configuration

goal: Inspect, validate and deliberately import/export supported data
attention: File/scope, validation result, conflicts and explicit apply boundary
waste: Flatten helper text and avoid unrelated decorative cards
navigation: Keep staged preview/validation before mutation, not a single magic upload
complexity: No silent overwrite, invented relationships or rollback promise
change: Condense into clear ordered operation sections using existing guards
tradeoff: An explicit confirm step is justified by data consequences; don't remove it as friction

goal: Change supported application and appearance settings
attention: Setting meaning, saved state and separate appearance axes
waste: Repeated generic section copy can shrink
navigation: Preserve reachable Settings on mobile More and existing independent saves
complexity: Authentication/application configuration must not be conflated with a visual theme preset
change: Keep current scopes; share field/error/feedback grammar
tradeoff: Moving utilities into More adds one navigation step but removes repeated chrome

goal: Manage a coherent group without pretending it is individual records
attention: Group identity, group quantity knowledge, location and lifecycle
waste: Same card/spacing issues as Plants; repeated labels can shrink
navigation: Retain explicit Plants type filter, not an invented top-level destination
complexity: Group count/quantity cannot be summed as active individual Plants
change: Same operational table choice as Plants, type visibly labelled; quantity stays domain-specific
tradeoff: A unified presentation still needs distinct group quantity and operation eligibility

archetype: App shell around all seven archetypes
goal: Reach destinations and essential utilities with minimal chrome
attention: Current location, task controls and content
waste: Duplicate utility/top-level bars push first useful content below the fold
navigation: Keep existing macro groups; bottom primary destinations plus More contains all utilities
complexity: Menus must work with keyboard/Escape/focus; no function silently disappears
change: Compact mobile brand/menu and bottom navigation; desktop forest rail is separately reviewable
tradeoff: Settings/Appearance/Sign out take one extra open; keyboard and focus contract must justify it
